decision_scope.approved_scope: Only exact pending rows in the pinned application stage; no population or coordinate changes.

source_sample_review.selection_policy: Targeted: up to 10 largest population pairs, 6 zero-population pairs, 10 pairs with inter-endpoint raw-name/region differences, and 6 pairs held on source-row checks. Seeded random: one pair from each of up to 20 randomly selected regions plus 8 ordinary pairs. Strata may overlap; total is at most 60.
source_sample_review.method_and_limit: For each sampled pair I reopened the 2002 workbook row and checked its typed settlement label and count; the 2002 input-manifest pins verified the workbook bytes. I reopened each sampled 2010 source row in its underlying XLS, archived HTML, or DOCX source. The DBF raw record bytes were checked by record number/byte offset, whole-file SHA, code segments, raw name/type, deletion marker, and coordinates; raw classifier records were checked by exact code/name/type against the cached 142/2009 source receipt. The sample is a rule-validation sample, not an estimate of national error rates; it does not replace the full machine gates or claim all 2002 source rows were independently re-opened.

scientific_scope.identity_witness: Each approved pair consists of two selected settlement observations with exact normalized name/type/region keys and singleton year signatures. Their independently accepted direct point-use origins resolve to the same literal nondeleted typed GeoKLADR 2011 DBF settlement record (same file SHA, DBF record number and byte offset); each record is tied to the exact 2009 classifier code/name/type, and the 2010 observation also passes direct raw publication row, type, population and region checks. The shared record is a source-object identity witness, not coordinate coincidence alone.
scientific_scope.administrative_scope: The check establishes regional agreement and a shared typed source object. It does not establish stable census-date districts, municipal borders, or legal OKATO code continuity. No contradictory event/graph role or exact competing same-year target was found in the frozen candidate gates.
scientific_scope.coordinates: Existing point uses were reused as provenance witnesses. This review admits no coordinate, provider ID, FIAS, OKTMO or census-date measurement claim.
scientific_scope.population: Population stays year-specific. It admits no comparability, growth, boundary stability or quality upgrade; approved IDs have 2002 sum 461324 and 2010 sum 430043 only as descriptive values in current selected source rows.

region_hold_detail.administrative_scope_conflict: Усть-Ордынский Бурятский округ → selected Иркутская область (41); this reflects a distinct historic administrative unit and is not treated as spelling normalization.
